% Chapters and parts in a report: a list of figures before the table of
% contents (the table of contents goes beside the text, and the list stays
% in the text), a part, two chapters with sections and a subsection, a
% figure, and an appendix.
\documentclass{report}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\title{Report}
\author{Someone}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\listoffigures
\tableofcontents
\part{Beginnings}
\chapter{First}
Some text.
\section{A section}
\begin{figure}
    \centering
    \fbox{A picture}
    \caption{A figure}
\end{figure}
\subsection{A subsection}
More text.
\chapter{Second}
\section{Another section}
The end.
\appendix
\chapter{Extra}
\section{More}
After the end.
\end{document}
